backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user profiles, daily challenge logic, and a waste-classification function with preset categories and tips.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend files for reference or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global CSS defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry defining metadata, icons, root mount point, and main script.
frontend/public/sw.js: Simple service worker handling install, cache population, fetch fallback, and old cache cleanup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with hash routing, theme provider, and route definitions.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper with header, offline/sync banners, service‑worker init, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading state and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with route-aware icons for primary pages.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog prompting new authenticated users to set a display name and create a profile.
frontend/src/components/scan/CameraGuida: Renders an overlay with framing guides and tips to assist users during camera scanning.
frontend/src/components/scan/ScanConfirm: Displays a scanned image preview, optional description input, and confirm/discard actions.
frontend/src/components/scan/scanTypes.t: Defines scan-related types and a helper for determining action button labels.
frontend/src/components/States.tsx: Provides reusable loading, empty, and error state UI components with optional actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and state.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineSync.ts: Syncs queued scan events when online and authenticated, handling errors and retries.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend calls for user profiles, scanning, and leaderboard using React Query.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines a light/dark eco-themed color system.
Implements mock text and image classification and queues results for backend sync.
frontend/src/lib/dailyChallenge.ts: Calculates daily challenge progress and reset logic based on timestamps.
frontend/src/lib/errors.ts: Normalizes camera errors into user-friendly messages with retry guidance.
frontend/src/lib/imagePreview.ts: Manages creation, transfer, and revocation of object URLs for image previews with lifecycle tracking.
frontend/src/lib/mockClassifier.ts: Provides a mock waste-classification database and lookup function using exact or partial text matches.
frontend/src/lib/offlineQueue.ts: Stores, retrieves, and manages a capped queue of offline classification events in localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/share.ts: Shares classification results using the Web Share API with clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/lib/speechRecognition.ts: Wraps browser speech recognition to start, stream results, handle errors, and stop listening.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Renders an informational page explaining Earth Eye’s mission, usage instructions, and features.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Displays the landing page with navigation cards for scanning, voice input, leaderboard, and about sections.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Shows authenticated users a leaderboard with loading, error, and empty states plus rank icons.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's profile, stats, and daily challenge status with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/ScanCamera.tsx: Manages camera-based or uploaded image scanning, preview handling, and classification workflow.
frontend/src/pages/ScanResults.tsx: Shows the classification results, including item details, points, fun facts, and navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/VoiceInput.tsx: Captures speech or text input to classify items and routes results to the results page.
frontend/src/state/scanSessionStore.ts: Stores, retrieves, and clears the current scan result, managing preview URL cleanup.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, containers, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing build state for the Earth Eye app and listing three pending feature requests related to adding and displaying the author name WAMIQ AHMAD. No issues or architectural notes are recorded.
